paragraphs.text: North Pontotoc took a one-point halftime lead into the locker room Tuesday in Glen, then outscored Alcorn Central 12-4 in the third quarter to win 31-26. The same night, the Pontotoc girls won at home, beating previously unbeaten Louisville 59-53.

The Vikings and Golden Bears finished the first quarter tied at six. North Pontotoc led 14-13 at halftime and 26-17 going into the fourth. Alcorn Central won the final quarter 9-5, cutting the margin to five. North Pontotoc moved to 5-1 and Alcorn Central to 1-2.

For the Pontotoc girls, the six-point win followed a 55-51 loss to Decatur on Saturday. Tuesday’s result put the Warriors at 3-1 and Louisville at 6-1. Pontotoc is scheduled to play at Tupelo on Thursday, Nov. 19, at 6 p.m.
North Pontotoc also goes back on the road Thursday. The Vikings are scheduled to play at Water Valley at 7 p.m. before hosting Biggersville at 7:30 p.m. Friday, Nov. 20.
